name: pdk-kedro-dagster-pipeline
instr:
Our regional sales project runs on Dagster through kedro-dagster, the package in /app. The vendor now splits each region's export into several batch files, so we map the batches onto per-region partitions with a StaticPartitionMapping in the catalog, and the FX rate files the same way (one currency file can feed several regions). `kedro run` gives the right numbers. The Dagster job doesn't: a region's summary only reflects one of its batches, some days the run fails, and the full job won't start at all.

A copy of the project with today's landing data is in /data/regional_sales. From that folder we run `dagster job execute -f /data/regional_sales/src/regional_sales/definitions.py -j local__summaries`, or `-j local__default` for the full job.

For any project using StaticPartitionMapping or IdentityPartitionMapping, each partition of a partitioned output should be built by its own op, and that op's node should get, for every partitioned input, exactly the partitions mapped to it, handed over the way `kedro run` hands a partitioned dataset to a node. If the node returns nothing for its partition, nothing is written and the run still succeeds. Partitioned outputs have to feed later nodes in the same job, partitioned or not. Dagster should record one materialization per partition written, under that partition's own key, from the op that built it.

The existing tests in /app/tests and the checks in /app/CLAUDE.md should keep passing. There's no network, and everything is installed
